title: The Crown three level keyboard cartridge

overrides.2750: IF N(40*(lv-1)+RM,1) THEN PRINT AT Y(RM),X(RM);INK 6;CHR$ 160
overrides.2960: RESTORE 5050+RM*100: FOR I=1 TO INT (RND*4+1): READ CX,CY: NEXT I: IF NOT POINT (cx*8+3,(21-cy)*8+4) THEN LET CHP=0: FOR I=1 TO H(M(RM)): LET CHP=CHP+INT (RND*8+1): NEXT I: PRINT AT CY,CX;INK 2;CHR$ (147+M(RM)): PRINT AT 21,17;C$(M(RM)): GO TO 2999

notes: Stock ON ERR is replaced by explicit converted control flow; VM errors remain visible.
Keyboard controls are retained; stock joystick port polling is disabled for this first build.
All three levels and their original UDG images are loaded from cartridge assets.
No files for levels 4 or 5 exist in the supplied TAP; the original main listing contains unused load clauses for them.
